intent: Build scenarios and graders for the twenty-one drills that have neither. benchmark/drills/graders/architecture/ and scenarios/architecture/ are the worked reference: ten graders, a toy repository, and tests asserting the set fails the untouched fixture and passes a correct tree. Until a drill has both it reports every criterion manual and no verdict, which is honest and is not evidence about a pack. The two Wave C drills need scenarios too, and the marketing one needs a product repository carrying a pricing page and eleven support tickets.
